arxiv-2109-06885.title: Far-Ultraviolet Spectra of Main-Sequence O Stars at Extremely Low Metallicity Astrodrizzle ( Gonzaga et al. 2012 ) , Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , beast ( Gordon et al. 2016 ) , dolphot ( Dolphin 2000 ; Dolphin 2016 ) , HDF5 ( The HDF Group 1997-
arxiv-2109-06885.creator: O. Grace Telford, John Chisholm, Kristen B. W. McQuinn, Danielle A. Berg
arxiv-2109-06885.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by O. Grace Telford, John Chisholm, Kristen B. W. McQuinn, Danielle A. Berg. Metal-poor massive stars dominate the light we observe from star-forming dwarf galaxies and may have produced the bulk of energetic photons that reionized the universe at high redshift. Yet, the rarity of observations of individual O stars below the 20% solar metallicity ( Z ⊙ Z_{\odot} ) of the Small Magellanic Cloud (SMC) hampers our ability to model the ionizing fluxes of metal-poor stellar populations.

arxiv-2212-11002.title: Stress tensors of 3d Carroll CFTs
arxiv-2212-11002.creator: Sudipta Dutta
arxiv-2212-11002.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sudipta Dutta. We discuss kinematical features of conformal Carroll field theories in three dimensions (3d). Conformal extension of Carroll algebra is infinite dimensional even in 3d unlike its relativistic counterpart, and hence 3d Carroll CFTs share similarities with 2d CFT. We provide a construction for the conserved charges for Carrollian CFTs and an expression for stress tensor OPEs consistent with the algebra of charges. We discuss a free field model where these symmetries are realised and explicitly compute the OPEs verifying our construction.

arxiv-2301-13438.title: Hopf-Rinow Theorem of sub-Finslerian geometry
arxiv-2301-13438.creator: Layth M. Alabdulsada and László Kozma
arxiv-2301-13438.description: Abstract . The sub-Finslerian geometry means that the metric F F is defined only on a given subbundle of the tangent bundle, called a horizontal bundle. In the paper, a version of the Hopf-Rinow theorem is proved in the case of sub-Finslerian manifolds, which relates the properties of completeness, geodesically completeness, and compactness.

arxiv-2405-15343.title: Distinguish Any Fake Videos: Unleashing the Power of Large-scale Data and Motion Features
arxiv-2405-15343.creator: Lichuan Ji, Yingqi Lin, Zhenhua Huang, Yan Han, Xiaogang Xu, Jiafei Wu, Chong Wang, Zhe Liu
arxiv-2405-15343.description: Abstract The development of AI-Generated Content (AIGC) has empowered the creation of remarkably realistic AI-generated videos, such as those involving Sora. However, the widespread adoption of these models raises concerns regarding potential misuse, including face video scams and copyright disputes. Addressing these concerns requires the development of robust tools capable of accurately determining video authenticity.

arxiv-2408-07033.title: Tame pairs of transseries fields
arxiv-2408-07033.creator: Nigel Pynn-Coates
arxiv-2408-07033.description: Abstract . This paper concerns pairs of models of the theory of the differential field of logarithmic-exponential transseries that are tame as a pair of real closed fields. That is, the smaller model is bounded inside the larger model and there exists a standard part map.

arxiv-2409-17770.title: Energy-scaling behavior of intrinsic transverse momentum parameters in Drell-Yan simulation
arxiv-2409-17770.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . An analysis is presented based on models of the intrinsic transverse momentum (intrisic \kt ) of partons in nucleons by studying the dilepton transverse momentum in Drell–Yan events. Using parameter tuning in event generators and existing data from fixed-target experiments and from hadron colliders, our investigation spans three orders of magnitude in center-of-mass energy and two orders of magnitude in dilepton invariant mass.

arxiv-2506-03676.creator: Zachary Crawford 1 , Adam Goga 1 , Mikael A. Kovtun 1 , and Gergely T. Zimanyi 1
arxiv-2506-03676.description: Abstract Due to recent advances, silicon solar cells are rapidly approaching the Shockley-Queisser limit of 33% efficiency. Quantum Dot (QD) solar cells have the potential to surpass this limit and enable a new generation of photovoltaic technologies beyond the capabilities of any existing solar energy modalities.

arxiv-2506-16007.title: Data-Agnostic Cardinality Learning from Imperfect Workloads
arxiv-2506-16007.creator: Peizhi Wu, Rong Kang, Tieying Zhang, Jianjun Chen, Ryan Marcus, Zachary G. Ives
arxiv-2506-16007.description: Abstract . Cardinality estimation (CardEst) is a critical aspect of query optimization. Traditionally, it leverages statistics built directly over the data. However, organizational policies (e.g., regulatory compliance) may restrict global data access. Fortunately, query-driven cardinality estimation can learn CardEst models using query workloads.

arxiv-2507-07776.title: Scooter : A Human Evaluation Framework for Unrestricted Adversarial Examples
arxiv-2507-07776.creator: Dren Fazlija, Monty-Maximilian Zühlke, Johanna Schrader, Arkadij Orlov, Clara Stein, Iyiola E. Olatunji, Daniel Kudenko
arxiv-2507-07776.description: Abstract Unrestricted adversarial attacks aim to fool computer vision models without being constrained by ℓ p \ell_{p} -norm bounds to remain imperceptible to humans, for example, by changing an object’s color. This allows attackers to circumvent traditional, norm-bounded defense strategies such as adversarial training or certified defense strategies.

arxiv-2509-02401.title: Towards Agents That Know When They Don’t Know: Uncertainty as a Control Signal for Structured Reasoning
arxiv-2509-02401.creator: Josefa Lia Stoisser, Marc Boubnovski Martell *, Lawrence Phillips, Gianluca Mazzoni, Lea Mørch Harder, Philip Torr, Jesper Ferkinghoff-Borg, Kaspar Märtens, Julien Fauqueur † \dagger
arxiv-2509-02401.description: Abstract Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in structured biomedical data environments, yet they often produce fluent but overconfident outputs when reasoning over complex multi-table data. We introduce an uncertainty-aware agent for query-conditioned multi-table summarization that leverages two complementary signals: (i) retrieval uncertainty—entropy over multiple table-selection rollouts—and (ii) summary uncertainty—combining self-consistency and perplexity.

This study aimed to clarify the inter-prefectural regional disparity and relationships between healthcare resources and representative surgical procedures using a nationwide database in Japan.

pmc-11459549.title: Primary Hyperparathyroidism With Undetectable Intact Parathyroid Hormone
pmc-11459549.creator: Zhixing Song, Jessica McMullin, Forest Huls, Richard Rosenthal, Sravani Bantu, Christopher Wu, Herbert Chen, Brenessa Lindeman
pmc-11459549.description: Hypercalcemia can result from either hyperparathyroidism or non-parathyroid conditions. When hypercalcemia is accompanied by undetectable parathyroid hormone (PTH) levels, hyperparathyroidism is rarely considered the diagnosis. Herein, we report the case of a 65-year-old Caucasian woman referred to our hospital for further evaluation of hypercalcemia. Her symptoms included fatigue and brain fog, with undetectable PTH levels.

pmc-11529387.title: Which One is Better Between Conservative and Surgical Procedure on Navicular Stress Fracture in Professional Runner: A Systematic Review
pmc-11529387.creator: Agya Ghilman Faza
pmc-11529387.description: Introduction:Stress fractures are common overuse injuries in the lower extremities. Stress fractures are most commonly observed in the tibia (24%), tarsal navicular (18%), metatarsal (16%), fibula (16%), femoral neck (5%). Navicular Stress Fracture (NSF) is becoming increasingly recognized in athletes, with an estimated prevalence about 35% of stress fractures in the foot and ankle.

pmc-12581405.title: Mycobacterium tuberculosis-induced oligodendrocyte apoptosis promotes astrocyte-mediated cell-in-cell formation and phagocytosis in tuberculous meningitis
pmc-12581405.creator: Jinli Feng, Feng Qiu, Zubiao Niu, Ming Fang, Jianghui Yang, Li Xiao, Jun Zhao, Qiang Sun, Jiatang Zhang
pmc-12581405.description: ObjectiveTo determine whether cell-in-cell (CIC) structures exist in tuberculous meningitis (TBM) and to explore their clinical significance.MethodsPathological brain biopsies from TBM patients were retrospectively analyzed using H&E and immunohistochemistry, with a focus on CIC structures. Multicolor immunofluorescence and in vitro coculture of astrocytes and oligodendrocytes were employed to explore CIC characteristics and underlying mechanisms.

This pilot study evaluated a calcium sulfate/hydroxyapatite (CaS/HA) material as an antibiotic-eluting BGE and a carrier for bone morphogenetic protein-2 (BMP-2) in a rabbit posterolateral lumbar (L4–L5) spinal fusion model (PLF).

pmc-13410276.description: Computer-aided de novo drug design has been widely explored for early-stage drug discovery, yet the multi-property optimization of novel molecules remains challenging. We developed a teacher–student-interaction deep learning model fine-tuned by reinforcement learning (TSItransRL) using bioactivity datasets (DRD2 and JNK3/GSK3β targets).
